tasks.title: Define scan-sheet domain types
tasks.dod: src/types/scan-sheet.ts exports InsertDocumentsPayload/InsertDocumentsItem, GetScanSheetPayload/ScanSheetDetail, ScanSheetListItem, DeleteScanSheetPayload/DeleteScanSheetItem, RemoveDocumentsPayload/RemoveDocumentsItem matching spec.md §1's quoted structs field-for-field; every Ref/DocumentRefs/ScanSheetRefs/CounterpartyRef field is inlined as string, no shared Ref alias imported from internet-document (sad.md §5); Count/DateTime/Date/Printed stay raw unparsed strings (sad.md §4 decision 6); zero any; tsc --noEmit and lint pass

tasks.title: Implement the 5 raw ScanSheet pass-through methods
tasks.dod: insertDocuments, getScanSheet, getScanSheetList, removeDocuments, and deleteScanSheet each delegate straight to client.request("ScanSheet", <method>, ...) with no requestEnvelope() use (sad.md §4 decision 2); insertDocuments passes DocumentRefs through unmodified and creates a new sheet on an omitted/empty Ref (AC-01) or adds to the given Ref (AC-02); getScanSheet accepts either Ref or CounterpartyRef and passes whichever is supplied through unmodified (AC-04, AC-05); removeDocuments/deleteScanSheet pass ScanSheetRefs/DocumentRefs through unmodified with no split/cap/reorder (AC-07, AC-09) and never call any waybill-invalidating endpoint (AC-08, AC-10); a mocked-fetch unit test per method asserts the request body shape and that a declined/malformed/network-failed call throws NovaPoshtaApiError (AC-11, AC-12, AC-13)

tasks.title: Implement addToTodaysScanSheet (convenience, match-or-create)
tasks.dod: addToTodaysScanSheet computes today's Europe/Kyiv calendar date via a module-local Intl.DateTimeFormat helper, calls getScanSheetList exactly once, filters to today's still-unprinted (Printed === "0") sheets and picks the highest DateTime when ≥1 match, then calls insertDocuments exactly once with the matched Ref (or an empty string to create a new one) and today's date (sad.md §6 Flow 2); a failed getScanSheetList call propagates its NovaPoshtaApiError without falling through to create a new sheet; mocked-fetch unit tests cover a 2+-match fixture (newest DateTime chosen), a zero-match fixture (new sheet created), and the getScanSheetList-failure propagation case

tasks.title: Wire scan-sheet module into the public package surface
tasks.dod: src/index.ts exports createScanSheetModule, ScanSheetModule, and every type from src/types/scan-sheet.ts; npm run build succeeds with matching dist/index.d.ts and dist/index.d.cts output

tasks.title: Unit test suite for scan-sheet
tasks.dod: test/unit/modules/scan-sheet.test.ts covers AC-01..AC-13 (100% of declined/malformed/network-failed calls throw NovaPoshtaApiError; 0% throw on a per-item Error/Errors value or an empty-but-successful batch array — ADR-0001, dedicated empty-array fixture for insertDocuments/removeDocuments/deleteScanSheet) and asserts median library-added overhead ≤5ms across ≥30 stubbed single-item calls to a raw method, addToTodaysScanSheet excluded, per spec.md §6 NFR row 5
